@graph.name: 3 Day Ijen, Bromo & Madakaripura Waterfall Discovery from Surabaya

review.reviewBody: I joined the 3-day, 2-night Bromo and Ijen volcano tour, and it was absolutely worth it! The scenery along the way was like a painting—I'd definitely do it all over again! 👍🏻 Highly recommend our guide Guforn—he was friendly and really took good care of everyone. He kept helping my friend who was on a mission to buy fruit the whole time—poor guy probably had his hands full with us! 🤣\n\nThe most unforgettable part was hiking in the dark early in the morning to see the blue fire. It was tiring, but the moment we saw that glowing blue flame, it felt like everything was totally worth it. I also met so many fun and interesting new friends. The whole trip was incredibly fulfilling and full of joy!
